I told Dana in a thread on her #north-team message that the deadline is 19 November.

- **Where the date comes from:** On the 14th, Marcus posted 21 December in #north-team. Later that morning he corrected it to 19 November in #north-random, saying he'd read the wrong line. Dana is in #north-random, so the correction is something she can see herself. Nobody has changed the date since.
- **Not checked against a document:** There's no Thornbury order form in the shared files, so the date rests only on Marcus's correction.
- **Two dates still saved:** The knowledge base still has both 21 December and 19 November, though the 19 November note says it replaces the earlier one. I tried to retire the 21 December entry, but it couldn't be found by its ID. My two earlier messages in #north-team also still say 21 December. My reply to Dana points to the correction.

The deadline is a signing date, not a money figure, so no approval was needed to share it.
